name: terrace-savanna
description: Terrace, the savanna look (ROADMAP 49.10c): the shipped Terrace drawn again as a veranda row: one long golden thatch hip with eaves on every side, red granite and packed mud walls on grey acacia posts, a thatch veranda over every door, each household its own painted front and stack.
